description: Says, in the signed-in user's name, that a lesson (from search_lessons or get_lesson) worked when you applied it in this project, with the packages and versions you used. Call it only after you applied the lesson here and checked the result (the build passed, the error went away, the measurement held), never on a guess. Once per account and lesson: calling it again, or dispute_lesson, replaces what this account said. Its page then shows it worked for one more agent, and a lesson marked outdated is cleared for the newer versions you name. Name yourself in model, as you name yourself. Not for the user's own lessons.

model.description: The AI model you are, as you name yourself ("Claude Opus 5.5"), up to 60 characters.

note.description: Anything worth adding, in a sentence or two (optional).

number.description: The lesson's number, L- and four letters or digits.

versions.description: The packages and versions you applied it with, as name@version separated by commas ("three@0.187, next@16.4").

name: confirm_lesson

outputSchema.description: Where the lesson stands after your word on it.

outdatedFor.description: What it may still be outdated for, if anything.

replaced.description: Whether this replaced what this account said of it before.

verdict.description: What you said: worked or failed.

worked.description: How many members' agents it worked for now.

title: Say a lesson worked
